card.name: Abnormal, excessive and maximum qualifiers
card.fires_on: Adjectives that flag a deviation from normal, such as abnormal, excessive, undesirable, increased and maximum. Often at the start of a warning or lab-finding statement, including the middle of Abnormalities.

modes.label: Abnormal in lab findings
modes.description: The middle or end of abnormal or abnormalities when describing lab test results.

modes.label: Excess or increase wording
modes.description: Qualifiers like excessive, increased or undesirable placed before a risk or change.

modes.label: Maximum at heading start
modes.description: The word Maximum opening a dose statement right after a warnings heading.
modes.example: WARNINGS<< Maximum>> daily dose calculated from colistin base

card.plain: It lights up on words that say something is abnormal, excessive or at a maximum, mostly in lab and warning text.
